question: The Koraput Revolution occurred in _____also known as the India August Movement or August Kranti during the Quit India Movement.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Orissa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Quit India Movement** is also known as the **India August Movement or August Kranti Movement.**
 
• The Quit** India Movement** was officially launched by the** Indian National Congress (INC)** led by** Mahatma Gandhi** on** 8 August 1942 **during **World War II **demanding an end to British rule in India.
 
• The main reason for** the Quit India Movement **was **Gandhiji's dislike of the return of Cripps pertaining to the British Government's Draft Declaration**. 
 
• During the launch of the **Quit India Movement** when** Mahatma Gandhi** delivered the famous slogan '**do or die**'.​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The United Provinces: It was a province in British India that roughly corresponded to the modern-day Indian states of **Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand. **
 
• In 1902,​ the province was known as the United Provinces of Agra and Oudh which in 1937 was shortened to United Province or UP.​
 
• History says Uttar Pradesh came into existence on **24th January 1950,** when the governor-general of India passed United Provinces in 1950, renaming United Provinces as Uttar Pradesh.
